description: This Python source file defines a recursive planning and task execution framework for deep research agents. It includes functions for topological sorting, task decomposition, dependency analysis, strategy decision-making, and orchestrating a comprehensive deep research process involving both web search and synthesis steps.

methods.name: List[List[str]] _build_topological_groups(tasks: List[Subtask])
methods.description: Builds groups of tasks that can run in parallel based on their dependencies (topological sort).

methods.name: List[List[str]] _get_execution_levels(tasks: List[Subtask])
methods.description: Fetches all execution levels within the task dependency graph, including non-parallelizable levels.

methods.name: ResearchPlan create_research_plan( research_question: str, max_depth: int = 3, max_tasks_per_level: int = 5, )
methods.description: Creates a recursive, dependency-aware research plan broken into subtasks with dependency analysis and grouping.

methods.name: List[Subtask] refine_task( task_description: str, parent_context: str = "", current_depth: int = 0, max_depth: int = 3, )
methods.description: Recursively refines a complex task into smaller subtasks until max depth is reached.

methods.name: TaskDependenciesList identify_dependencies( tasks: List[dict], research_question: str )
methods.description: Analyzes task descriptions to determine dependencies, forming a dependency graph among tasks.

methods.name: TaskMergeList deduplicate_tasks(tasks: List[dict], research_question: str)
methods.description: Detects and merges duplicate or similar tasks to optimize the task list.

methods.name: SearchStrategy decide_search_strategy( task_description: str, research_question: str, dependency_findings: List[TaskResult], )
methods.description: Decides whether a task should be answered via synthesis of dependencies or augmented with external search.

methods.name: TaskResult _execute_task_smart( task: Subtask, research_question: str, completed_results: dict[str, TaskResult], )
methods.description: Executes a task intelligently, routing to web search or synthesis based on dependencies and strategy.

methods.name: ResearchReport execute_deep_research( research_question: str, max_depth: int = 3, max_tasks_per_level: int = 5, )
methods.description: Performs complete deep research by creating the plan, executing tasks in order, and synthesizing a final report.

methods.name: List[Subtask] refine_recursively( task: Subtask, parent_context: str = "" )
